features.definition: How much of the creature's body is blue/cyan colored. 0=no blue at all, 1=almost entirely blue
How much of the creature's body is green colored. 0=no green, 1=almost entirely green
How much of the creature's body is brown/tan colored. 0=no brown, 1=almost entirely brown
How much of the creature's body is red, pink, or magenta. 0=none, 1=almost entirely red/pink
How much of the creature's body is yellow or orange. 0=none, 1=almost entirely yellow/orange
How much of the creature's body is gray, black, or dark metallic. 0=none, 1=almost entirely gray/black
How much of the creature's body is white or very pale. 0=none, 1=almost entirely white
Whether the creature has visible wings or wing-like appendages
Whether the creature has aquatic fins or a fish-like tail
Whether the creature has tentacles or tentacle-like appendages
Whether the creature stands upright on two legs
Whether the creature stands on four legs
Whether the creature lacks clear limbs and has a blob-like or spherical body. 0=clear limbed body, 1=completely amorphous/round
Visual complexity of the design: number of appendages, patterns, details. 0=very simple/smooth, 1=extremely complex with many details
How large/bulky the creature appears to be. 0=tiny/small, 1=very large/massive
How fierce, aggressive, or intimidating the creature looks. 0=cute/gentle, 1=very fierce/menacing
How cute or adorable the creature appears. 0=not cute at all, 1=extremely cute
Whether the creature resembles an insect or arachnid (exoskeleton, multiple limbs, pincers)
Whether the creature has a body adapted for water (streamlined, fish-like, marine). 0=fully terrestrial, 1=fully aquatic
Whether the creature is bird-like (beak, feathers, bird body plan)
Whether the creature resembles a mammal (fur, mammalian face, warm-blooded appearance)
Whether the creature resembles a reptile or dinosaur (scales, reptilian features)
Whether the creature has plant-like features (leaves, petals, vines, roots)
Whether the creature appears mechanical, rocky, or mineral-based rather than organic. 0=fully organic, 1=fully mechanical/mineral
Whether the creature has a visible shell, exoskeleton, or armor plating
Whether the creature has prominent spikes, horns, or pointed protrusions
Whether the creature appears to be airborne or floating rather than grounded. 0=grounded, 1=fully airborne
How many distinct major colors appear on the creature. 0=monochromatic (1 color), 1=very colorful (5+ colors)

notes: These are Pokémon images. Natural groupings could be based on visual characteristics that correlate with type, evolutionary stage, body plan, color, size impression, and design complexity. I'll design features covering: dominant color, body structure (bipedal, quadruped, flying, aquatic, amorphous), apparent size/bulk, complexity, presence of wings/fins/tentacles, organic vs mechanical appearance, cuteness vs fierceness, and other visual traits.
